system.description: Closed Essence 14.3.5 - Familiar Mastery. Spells to call, locate, extend the range of, and share senses/resistance with a familiar, bind a true familiar, and share souls between caster and familiar.

Caster calls out to his familiar, summoning it to his location. The familiar will instinctively know the direction to the caster and begin moving in that direction at best speed. If the caster moves while the familiar is in transit, he will have to cast this spell again for the familiar to know his new location.

Allows the caster and his familiar to combine their senses, and use those best suited for their surroundings. This means that they will both receive +20 to all Observation and Alertness maneuvers for the duration. For this spell to work, the familiar must be 'in range' of this spell.

The caster can attune himself to a small creature (of creature intelligence) to serve as his familiar. The caster must obtain the creature through normal means and cast this spell on the creature once per day for 2 weeks (concentrating for 4 hours per day). The caster can then control the familiar and view the world through its senses by concentrating on it (though the familiar must be within 50' per level). See Section 10.2 for more information about True Familiars.
Caster will know the exact distance and direction to the familiar, at that moment, if it is within range of this spell.
Allows the caster's familiar to be considered 'in range' up to 100' per level.

The caster can take any damage to his familiar upon himself if he wishes. In addition, the caster can choose to send any damage he has suffered to his familiar instead (this must be done when the wound occurs to the caster).

Allows the caster to store one spell in the familiar. Whenever the caster desires, the spell will be instantly cast as though the caster were in the location of the familiar. The familiar must be 'in range' for the stored spell to be activated, and the caster may not cast any other spells until the stored spell is discharged.
As Call Familiar I, except for range.
As Range Extension I, except for range.
Allows the caster to converse in the general language of the familiar. Thus a caster with a bird familiar could talk to other avians, a caster with a snake familiar could talk to other reptiles.
As Locate Familiar I, except for range.

Allows caster and familiar to share their resistance to magic, poison, and disease, using those most advantageous to their environment. This results in a +20 to all RRs for the duration. If either caster or familiar fails a RR, they both suffer the consequences of failure.
Instantly teleports the familiar to the caster's side as long as the familiar is 'in range'.
As Call Familiar I, except for range.
As Range Extension I, except for range.
As Locate Familiar I, except for range.
Allows the caster to instantly teleport to the familiar's location as long as the familiar is 'in range'.
As Call Familiar I, except for range.
As Range Extension I, except for range.

This spell goes into effect the instant the caster or familiar's soul leaves its body. The soul is stored in the body of the other until the other body can be restored to a condition where it can survive again (this may require a variety of healing spells), or until 1 day per level of the caster has elapsed. If the caster or familiar (whichever one did not die) is killed while carrying both souls, both souls depart as normal.
The caster and familiar are able to act and think in perfect unison for the duration. The caster may cast any lower level spell from this list once per round.
